title: Build profile detection tool wrongly excludes `Mutex`, `Time`, and `Window` classes, breaking the build
body:
### Tested versions

N/A since it is not Godot version problem, but rather a compiling bug of some sort.

It is problem with either Godot's build system or something else on my PC. It worked fine a few weeks ago, when i last tried.

It happens with the master branch source fork as of now:

```
godot master *% = $ git log -1
commit 78d91947f689ea9eb4049f4d6371c0dfcfa0e62f (HEAD -> master, origin/master, origin/HEAD)
Merge: 877b113afa 22daf7826d
Author: Rémi Verschelde <rverschelde@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Dec 4 15:53:06 2025 +0100

    Merge pull request #113557 from bruvzg/test_prof_clean

    Fix profiler cleanup with `--test`.
```

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631.6199) - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Radeon RX550/550 Series (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.21923.11000) - Intel(R) Pentium(R) CPU G4400 @ 3.30GHz (2 threads) - 15.94 GiB memory

### Issue description

I am trying to build the export template for my project using this command which previously worked fine `scons p=windows -j 2 target=template_release tools=no build_profile="build.gdbuild"`
